source_snapshot.procedure: 100 complete physical tray AC removals/restorations; verify OS, PCIe, MCTP, SSIF and FPGA stability each cycle.
source_snapshot.criteria: Reliable OS boot and constant PCIe/MCTP enumeration plus SMA stability; Vera Rubin NVL72 guide is TBD.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; 30 attended and 1,440 machine minutes; unique code.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO/none; correctly assigns physical AC cycling to an operator but mentions only PCIe/MCTP/SMA evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY at CRITICAL risk; preserves 100 physical cycles and flags SSIF/FPGA versus SMA wording.

old_problem: Procedure requires SSIF and FPGA stability while Criteria names SMA; the former review requested a choice among them. Choosing one would delete another authoritative field. Physical tray AC removal, exact feed boundary, 100-cycle electrical controls and recovery also cannot be replaced by an agent or a warm/DC cycle.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict without reducing coverage. ED-09/ED-19 keep all physical AC actions operator-owned; ED-14 preserves exactly 100 cycles; ED-35 requires the union of non-equivalent source requirements when no approved rule permits deletion. Therefore SSIF, FPGA and SMA all become independent per-cycle branches. Exact endpoint manifests, guide revision, feed mapping, timing and thresholds remain fail-closed Project Configuration rather than an unresolved review decision.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1927, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were read. The actual next queue identity was directly opened as Functionality row 1928 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00011-V003 / f378df4e0f166d54.
SSIF, FPGA health and SMA are not synonyms. Testing all three preserves both Procedure and Criteria and is stricter than selecting or silently substituting one.
All 100 complete tray AC removals/restorations remain required. A sample, warm reboot, BMC chassis cycle or logical power state cannot cross-credit physical AC-loss coverage.
An authorized electrical/hardware operator binds and operates the exact tray feed. Automation may only collect read-only post-restore evidence and maintain the immutable cycle ledger.
Each cycle stops on the first unsafe connector/inrush, boot, endpoint, storage, thermal, power or recovery anomaly; no automatic retry may hide intermittent failure.
No AC, connector, PDU, reboot, protocol, log, recovery, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: 100 physical tray AC cycles with OS, PCIe, MCTP, SSIF, FPGA and SMA recovery
test_case.purpose: Have an authorized operator complete exactly 100 full AC-loss/restoration cycles on the exact tray feed while proving each recovery reaches OS Ready with stable PCIe, MCTP, SSIF, FPGA and SMA identity/health.
required_package: Approved Vera Rubin NVL72 guide revision and exact tray/PSU/feed/PDU/outlet/connector plus auxiliary-power boundary
Authorized electrical/hardware operator, facility approval, PPE/ESD/connector/inrush controls and timestamped physical evidence
Approved 100-cycle off/discharge/on/POST/OS timing, workload/storage drain, data protection and maintenance window
Expected PCIe/link, MCTP/EID/route, SSIF transaction, FPGA identity/status and SMA identity/health manifests with limits
Independent console/power observer, immutable 1-100 ledger, artifact storage, halt/recovery procedure and workload-restore authority
test_case.test_command: MANUAL ONLY; after target/feed binding, safety inspection, workload drain and point-of-action approval, an authorized operator physically removes all AC from the exact tray and restores it according to the approved off/discharge/on sequence for cycles 1-100, recording synchronized feed/power evidence. After each restoration, read-only collection proves Boot ID transition and OS Ready, then compares complete PCIe/link, MCTP endpoint/route, SSIF transaction, FPGA identity/status and SMA identity/health plus complete error/storage/thermal/power windows. Seal each ledger entry before advancing and stop on the first anomaly. Do not automate unlabeled connectors, reduce the denominator, substitute warm/DC cycling or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: For each of exactly 100 documented physical AC cycles, the correct tray fully loses and safely regains AC, reaches OS Ready within limits, and every expected PCIe, MCTP, SSIF, FPGA and SMA identity/health check plus platform evidence meets its approved oracle. No cycle is missing, duplicated, substituted or overwritten.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires 100/100 physical feed events, complete OFF/discharge/restore and OS Ready proof, and direct success for all six named domains on every cycle. FAIL on unsafe physical behavior, incomplete AC loss, boot timeout, missing/downtrained device, any MCTP/SSIF/FPGA/SMA mismatch, error/data/thermal/power anomaly, ledger gap or retry censorship. NOT READY applies when feed mapping, guide, manifests, limits, operator approval or recovery is absent. Reduced samples and warm/DC evidence cannot PASS; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Physical AC handling is human-only; verify exact labeled feed, electrical authorization, connector condition and all auxiliary feeds before cycle 1.
Drain and protect workloads/storage and preserve first-failure evidence; never continue after arcing, damage, abnormal inrush or incomplete power state.
Require independent console/power observation and stop on boot, endpoint, data, thermal, power or recovery fault.
Never auto-retry, silently replace a cycle or use PDU automation unless separately safety-validated and exact-outlet bound.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant, guide, tray/feed map, electrical/workload approvals, operator and 100-cycle timings
Immutable ledger 1-100 with timestamped physical AC removal/discharge/restoration and independent console/power/OS Ready trace
Per-cycle normalized PCIe/link, MCTP/EID/route, SSIF, FPGA and SMA comparisons
Complete per-cycle kernel/AER/DPC/BMC/storage/thermal/power evidence and first-failure preservation
100/100 completeness, no-substitution/no-auto-retry audit, final inspection/health, workload restore and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On unsafe connector/PSU behavior, incomplete AC state, boot timeout, endpoint mismatch, data, thermal, power or access anomaly, stop physical cycling and seal the failed-cycle evidence. Keep the tray de-energized or in the documented safe state chosen by the electrical owner; do not reconnect, retry or use another cycle class automatically. Follow the approved independent hardware/console recovery, inspect feed/connectors/PSUs and platform health, and require explicit owner release before any continuation.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure and Criteria are reconciled by testing the union—SSIF, FPGA and SMA—on every cycle. No named coverage is discarded or treated as equivalent.

blocked.reason: Purpose, physical method, acceptance and recovery boundaries are complete; exact guide/feed/oracles/limits are fail-closed runtime Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Guide revision, exact tray/feed and auxiliary-power boundary, 100-cycle timing, per-domain manifests/limits, electrical operator/workload approvals and independent recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO MANUAL 100-CYCLE COVERAGE-UNION TEST; NO AC, CONNECTOR, PDU, REBOOT, PROTOCOL, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.application: Keeps physical action human-owned, preserves all 100 cycles and retains the union of non-equivalent source coverage.

project_authority: Platform/electrical owners bind guide, feed, timings, endpoint oracles and recovery; an authorized operator performs the physical actions and the end user owns verdict. They cannot omit SSIF, FPGA or SMA, reduce 100 cycles or cross-credit warm/DC tests without an approved source correction.
